meta.method: Depth pass on cultural garments and bath towels: web search plus direct page fetches of brand/retailer sites already represented in research-clothing-cultural.json, -2.json, -3.json and research-clothing-towels.json, looking for additional products from the same brands rather than new brands. Each price is the exact figure for a specific named product and size as shown on the page fetched in this session, or as stated in a single search-result snippet quoting that named product's page; nothing was converted, averaged or estimated from a price range. Where only a 'from'/range price covering several sizes was found and no single confirmed per-item price could be read (Christy via John Lewis, Dunelm, Brooklinen individual towels, Pottery Barn beyond its existing two entries, John Lewis ANYDAY, Africa Imports, Alpenclassics, Andaaz Fashion, Fabindia, Harris Tweed Hebrides, Havanera beyond its one existing SKU, The Heritage of Scotland, JapaneseStyle.com yukatas, Magee 1866 waistcoats, M&S beyond ranges), that brand was left at its existing count rather than padded with a guessed figure. Several pages returned 403/404 on direct fetch (Christy's own site via John Lewis variant pages, INAYAH's own storefront, Magee 1866's US cap page, Dusk's Monaco page, Brooklinen's plush towel page, Macy's Hotel Collection page); for those, a single-price search-result snippet was used instead where one named a specific product and price, marked confirmed:false.
meta.checked: 2026-10-05: dropped for lack of a single confirmed per-item price rather than a range: Dunelm Egyptian Cotton Towel, Brooklinen Plush Bath Towel (sold only in sets of 2 at $99, price-per-towel would be a division, not a shown price), JapaneseStyle.com Japanese Navy Koi Fish Yukata ($59.95-$69.95 by size, no single size price read), M&S Pure Cotton Super Plush Ribbed Bath Towel (range only on both US and UK sites), Magee 1866 Donegal Tweed Baker Cap (US product page 404'd after indexing).
